scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/office
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n pkg,api,office -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev:packages" "npm:dev -w apps/api" "npm:dev -w apps/office"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w packages/i18n -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/office/tsconfig.json --noEmit
